title: G02: running-coupling integration contract: s_G = λ_G = 2b_0 and the public running input (refs #136)
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #136
Refs #26

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/136#issuecomment-6854439459, `ADB991-claude-20261113-6470`.
- Outputs: `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/G02/` only. Files: `README.md`, `ledger.md`, `proposed-patches.md`, `proposed.patch`. No chapter, Lean, include, preamble, glossary, bibliography or review file is changed.
- Contributors: Andrea Di Biagio (@ADB991), account holder. Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This is the G02 running-coupling integration contract (`handoff/G02.md`). It closes the second half of G04-F1 and the open "$s_G$ match" in G05.

- **$s_G=\lambda_G=2b_0(G)$, and the manuscript forces it.** The reset returns $\beta_i=\beta_{i+1}+\alpha_{N,i}+d_i$ with $|d_i|\le1$ (`coupling-reset-selection`). The path step has $|\alpha_{N,i}+\lambda_G\log L_i|+1\le D_{i+1}$. Together they give `eq:shoot-adjacent-drift` with slope $\lambda_G$; any other slope fails. In the source there is one constant, `YM.Gauge.slopeConstant`, used by `YM.RG.Calendar.hatBeta`, `YM.RG.History.Transfer`, `YM.Precision.Kin.kinetic` and `YM.Pressure.betaF`. The ledger classifies every alias ($s_G$, $\lambda_G$, $c_G$, $\kappa$, $b$) in 22 chapters.
- **Same history and uniformity.** The shooting estimate is exactly `eq:running` of `sec:running-coefficient`: the same $\beta_{N,p,m}$, intercept $\bar\beta$, $s_m=\log a_m^{-1}$, uniform in $N\ge m$ and $p$ (source: `YM.RG.History.Running`).
- **$N=m$.** Proposed `prop:shoot-public-running` derives `ex-running-input` with $\sigma=2b_0(G)$ from `prop:uniform-extraction` at $m=N$. This is the manuscript form of `YangMills.regular`.
- **Integration.** Include the running-coefficient section before `surviving-interval-shooting` (I1), and add `hall2000`/`lebl` to `existence.tex`'s bibliography (I2).

Uncertain or open:
- O1: all patches are proposals for their owners or F01.
- O2: the identification of the public family with the selected run ($D_N=e^{S_N}$, $\beta_{N,p}=\beta_{N,p,N}$) is the source definition `YangMills.wilsonFamily`. The manuscript states it nowhere, so it stays an explicit hypothesis of the proposition and of remark P7.
- O3: the $\kappa$ rows rely on the C14 and C15 evidence files.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Manuscript base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `bac6004`.

  - `latexmk -g -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error existence.tex` on the patched tree: exit 0, 971 pp, no LaTeX warnings, no undefined references. Pages 604, 607, 609, 961 and 970 were rendered and inspected.
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: "Blueprint structure OK: 4 units."
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
- Checks not performed and why: no Lean elaboration or `#print axioms`, because the Mathlib hosts are blocked in this sandbox. The trace-flux anchors for $\kappa$ were not re-inspected.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none applied. If applied, P1 changes C11 `surviving-interval-shooting` (new label `eq:shoot-slope`, new `prop:shoot-public-running`). It also adds one-line pointers in C16, C02, C12, C14, C15, G05 and the assembly, plus the includes in `existence.tex`. Those chapters would then need renewed review.
